seo.title: Services — Apex Home Services
seo.description: Handyman, electrical, light remodel, and exterior services across the Kansas City metro. Licensed, bonded, insured. Written quotes before any work starts.

header.heading: Our Services
header.lead: Four trades under one shop. Eight crew members, four trucks, one number to call. Each trade is staffed by crew members who specialize in it — and led by an owner who's still on every estimate.

cta.heading: Not sure which trade fits?
cta.body: That's exactly what the request form is for. Tell us what's going on and we'll route you to the right crew member — even if it's not at our shop.
